info.name: TIP Email Manager - Edit Template, per Recipient Mode
info.description:
Edit (EM-9) for each recipient mode. Edit needs an ACTIVE template, so each flow first authors v1 and gets it approved (S steps), then edits it (E steps): start edit -> v2 draft pre-filled -> adopt latest query version -> edit content -> edit recipients (mode-specific) -> submit -> approval queue -> approve -> history -> compare.

Query under test: select ca_name, ca_type, status, email, name from em_contact where status=:status

Needs two different users: maker (author/submitter) and checker (Sr. Analyst or Manager - approves and reads history). The run halts at the first unexpected status and prints the response body.
